sloka: अर्द्यमानस्ततस्तेन दुर्धरेणानिलात्मजः ।चकार कदनं भूयो व्यवर्धत च वेगवान् ।। ५.४६.२४।।।।
transliteration: ardyamānastatastena durdhareṇānilātmajaḥ ।cakāra kadanaṁ bhūyo vyavardhata ca vegavān ।। 5.46.24।।।।

translations.english: When the son of the Windgod was attacked by Durdhara, he again grew in size
